prose: BleepingComputer reports that hackers are abusing legitimate Bing search-result redirects as click URLs in Google search ads to send users to fake Claude installers delivering ClickFix attacks. Push Security researchers dubbed the technique 'Adception': using Bing's trusted domain as the ad destination appears designed to slip past advertising security checks before victims are bounced through a compromised site to the malicious download page.

The campaign surfaced after researchers spotted a malicious Google ad targeting searches for 'claude mac'. The attack layers cloaking so security scanners and direct visitors never see the payload, a more evasive pattern than typical malvertising.
highlights: Fake Claude installers pushed through Google ads
Bing redirects abused as trusted click URLs ('Adception')
Victims bounced through compromised sites to the payload
Campaign found via ads targeting 'claude mac' searches
Layered cloaking hides the payload from scanners
